name: What are the risks of DIY gas line rerouting?

mainEntity.name: What are the risks of DIY gas line rerouting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attempting to reroute a gas line without professional expertise carries significant risks, including gas leaks, explosions, carbon monoxide poisoning, and severe property damage. Improper installation can lead to long-term safety hazards and potential fines for non-compliance with local building codes. Always rely on licensed and insured plumbing professionals like Alpha-Plumbing Services to ensure the safety and integrity of your gas system.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY gas line rerouting poses serious risks like leaks, explosions, and carbon monoxide poisoning; always use licensed professionals.
